text:
nina-cs: Heads-up: Larkspur wants go-live signoff but their security lead reported two blockers: KMS key rotation disabled and audit logs failing with AccessDenied. They mentioned renewal conversation next week so this is high priority.

tom-infra: Looking at their account. CMK is customer-managed; rotation flag is off. I can flip rotation on; it's safe (no rewrap required). I'll hold until we confirm the logging path.

ashley-se: Logs show `403: Forbidden` from our uploader when writing to their bucket. The bucket policy grants PutObject to a user ARN, not the role we use for priv deployments. Need them to add the role principal: `arn:aws:iam::777777777777:role/redwood-priv-uploader`.

nina-cs: Customer message: "We cannot accept non-compliant logs for SOC2. If logs aren't in place we will pause." That's a direct renewal risk.

tom-infra: Proposed remediation: enable rotation now; request an S3 policy patch and recommend SSE-KMS using their CMK. For retention: suggest 60d hot, 305d archive to Glacier Deep. I can draft an email with cost estimate.

ashley-se: I'll add a quick installer check that fails with a clear message when bucket policy lacks the role principal. Current error is vague. Will open a PR and link the docs.

ops-bot: ticket created: CS-9021 "Larkspur priv deploy logging & KMS"

nina-cs: Action items: tom - enable rotation + send retention cost delta; ashley - installer validation PR + docs note; i'll coordinate with customer to apply bucket policy change and schedule dry run tomorrow 11:00 PT. Renewal state: amber -> move to green after logs flow.

tom-infra: Enabling rotation now. 3470001150

ops-bot: deploy job started for branch feat/installer-s3-check at 3470001160

ops-bot: deploy job success at 3470001175

ashley-se: PR opened #4218 with installer check and improved error text. 3470001176

tom-infra: Received confirmation from customer that they updated the bucket policy to include our role; first PutObject success seen 3470001180. Sample: `PutObject OK, x-amz-server-side-encryption: aws:kms`.

nina-cs: Great, updating renewal tracker to green and filing docs request to include an S3 policy example + SSE-KMS guidance. I'll follow up with Larkspur on retention proposal. Thanks team :thumbsup:
